delegation.record_status: Historical brief transcription for rejected, zero-credit D-07 evidence only. It is not an active dispatch authorization and does not establish a routing-quality PASS or retry.

classification.risk: low; no product, trading, financial, architecture, or code-organization decisions

delegation.task: Inventory historical D-07 history and retired-name references in the supplied sanitized repository snapshot. Do not edit any file. Do not recommend fixes, choose ownership, infer product meaning, or make business, trading, architecture, module-boundary, or code-organization decisions.
delegation.required_method: Use ripgrep with PCRE2, line numbers, and no heading. For each exact pattern independently, report: matching-line count, distinct-file count, and the sorted list of matching production or tooling files under apps, packages, scripts, and .github with their per-file matching-line counts. Also report the top 25 files across the full allowed scope ranked by total matching-line count, then lexical path. Count matching lines, not raw substring matches. Run every aggregate query twice and report whether the two results agree. A zero-match query is valid and must be reported as zero, not as a command failure.
delegation.prohibitions: Do not write or edit files. Do not run tests, builds, package installation, network calls, Git mutation, or destructive commands. Do not inspect excluded paths. Do not display file contents beyond the matched token, path, line number, and aggregate counts. Do not label a match safe, removable, active, obsolete, or compatible; this task is inventory only.
delegation.verification_loop: Confirm the workspace remains byte-for-byte unchanged according to Git status. Confirm every reported count is reproduced by the second run. If either condition cannot be proven, return a blocked result and explain only the missing evidence.
